definition: NFS is a network protocol that lets clients access shared files.
SMB is a network protocol that lets clients access shared files.
An object key identifies an S3 object and corresponds to its file path through S3 File Gateway.
A cache keeps recently accessed data locally to reduce retrieval latency.
For cache refresh, TTL is the time since a directory refresh after which access triggers another refresh.
iSCSI carries storage commands over an IP network so a server can access gateway devices.
A snapshot is a point-in-time backup that can be used to recover a volume.
An upload buffer is local staging storage for data waiting to be transferred to AWS.
A virtual tape library presents software tape drives and a media changer to backup applications.
An asynchronous upload transfers data after the local write rather than requiring both to finish together.
